mapper.sql: SELECT rp.*, p.place_name, p.region, p.category, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.image_url, COALESCE(tr.content_id, ( SELECT cp2.content_id FROM content_places cp2 WHERE cp2.place_id = rp.place_id ORDER BY cp2.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 )) AS related_content_id, ( SELECT c2.title FROM contents c2 WHERE c2.content_id = COALESCE(tr.content_id, ( SELECT cp3.content_id FROM content_places cp3 WHERE cp3.place_id = rp.place_id ORDER BY cp3.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 )) ) AS related_content_title, COALESCE(( SELECT cp4.relation_description FROM content_places cp4 WHERE cp4.place_id = rp.place_id AND cp4.content_id = COALESCE(tr.content_id, ( SELECT cp5.content_id FROM content_places cp5 WHERE cp5.place_id = rp.place_id ORDER BY cp5.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 )) LIMIT 1 ), p.description) AS scene_description FROM route_places rp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = rp.place_id LEFT JOIN travel_routes tr ON tr.route_id = rp.route_id
mapper.select: WHERE rp.route_id = #{routeId} ORDER BY rp.day_number ASC, rp.visit_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE route_places SET place_id = #{placeId}, day_number = #{dayNumber}, visit_order = #{visitOrder}, recommended_time = #{recommendedTime}, reason = #{reason}, travel_tip = #{travelTip} WHERE route_place_id = #{routePlaceId}
